notes.title: Patch notes for v0.16.2
notes.notes:
- EXP progress for next rank is now also shown in the post-game stats screen.
- Fixed a bug where the system message for destroying an Altar would show the incorrect number of Altars remaining when using a Charmed Flashlight in conjunction with the Last Hope perk.
- Fixed a bug where cards added to the top of the deck by the Mirrorgeist weren't included in its shuffle animation.
- Fixed a bug where the Altar card moved to the top of the deck by the Lucky Find perk would sometimes remain visible after the animation completes.
- Fixed various bugs related to the cursor sprite not updating correctly when hovering over UI elements under certain conditions.
- Fixed a bug where certain UI sound effects would play for buttons not visible on-screen.

notes.title: May 10th Hotfix
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug where the Horrifying Reflections counter would appear when playing against demons other than the Mirrorgeist.

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.16.1
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug that prevented the Mirrorgeist from shuffling itself into the top 6 cards of the deck when revealed by a Charmed Flashlight.

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.16.0
notes.notes:
- A new demon, [b]The Mirrorgeist[/b], has been added. This demon is available for play immediately.
- A new perk, [b]Chainsaw Hero[/b], has been added. This perk can be unlocked via the Fate Store.
- A new stopwatch model has been added to the Fate Store, along with a set of coloured skins.
- Updated the description on item cards that can't be charmed (Bone and Chainsaw) for clarification.
- Fixed a bug where certain visual effects wouldn't play when encountering the same jumpscare multiple times in a row.
- Fixed a bug where the stopwatch's warning audio would stop playing when investigating at 10 seconds or less.
- Minor UI improvements.

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.15.3
notes.notes:
- Players will now gain an additional 5 EXP for each altar destroyed on a game loss. For example, losing a game with 5 altars destroyed will grant a total of 50 EXP. This bonus is not applied when winning a game.
- When selecting the "Random" demon option in the lobby, the randomly selected demon will now appear after all demon card selections have been made.
- A list of rank titles and their corresponding ranks has been added to the player profile screen, accessable via the "Titles" button.
- The wording on the Bone card's description has been updated to clarify its function.
- Minor UX improvements.

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.15.2
notes.notes:
- Equipped card effects will now display on character cards in the lobby.
- Fixed an issue with the in-game system messages text rendering incorrectly.
- Fixed an issue where the ESC key would open the settings menu instead of closing the store/profile screens.

notes.title: Patch notes for v0.15.1
notes.notes:
- Added logs to help identify the cause of a rare bug preventing players from dragging an equipped item card under certain conditions.
- Added some protection against the bug mentioned above.
- Fixed a bug that occasionally prevented launching the game in offline mode.

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.15.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]The game can now be launched while running Steam in offline mode.[/b] While offline, single-player games can be played in full. Fate Tokens, stats, and achievements will be updated the next time the player launches the game while online. The Fate Store and unlockables will become inaccessible when launching in offline mode.
[*] Certain game actions are now prevented whilst the Bone throw animation is playing.
[/list]
